field_name: Calibrated Confidence Threshold Routing for Collaborative Inference

categories.name: Calibration Methods
categories.description: Techniques to adjust model confidence scores to reflect true likelihoods, including temperature scaling, isotonic regression, and Platt scaling.

categories.name: Selective Prediction / Routing
categories.description: Framework where models make predictions or defer based on confidence thresholds, including accept-defer rules and cascaded inference.

categories.name: Ensemble Confidence Calibration
categories.description: Calibrating the confidence of ensemble models (e.g., for sound event detection or audio deepfake detection).

categories.name: Domain-specific Applications
categories.description: Application of calibration and selective prediction to specific tasks such as NER, skin lesion classification, biosecurity, and financial forecasting.

idea_position: Calibration Methods + Selective Prediction / Routing (combining post-hoc calibration of diverse models with common thresholds for routing decisions)
dominant_approaches: Threshold-based routing (constrained cost minimization, accept-defer rules)
common_assumptions: Held-out validation data is available and representative of the test distribution.
Standard calibration methods are effective for each model type.
Common thresholds can be set meaningfully after calibration (e.g., by optimizing a validation metric).
common_datasets: Global equity indices for stock market forecasting

repeated_limitations.description: Assumption of large-model accuracy invariance to routing may not hold in other domains, breaking theoretical optimality.
Reliance on isotonic regression or temperature scaling requiring a calibration set adds overhead and may not generalize.
Focus on specific structured outputs (e.g., JSON extraction) may limit generalization to other formats.
Calibration quality varies across datasets due to small sample sizes or distribution shift.
Answer-order instability indicates sensitivity to trivial perturbations, questioning robustness of confidence estimates.
Limited generalizability due to focus on a single commercial model or specific domain.

underexplored_combinations: Calibrating diverse model architectures (e.g., decision trees, k-NN, LLMs) and using a unified reliability metric across them.
Theoretical analysis linking calibration error to expected selective risk under distribution shift.
Empirical evaluation of common thresholds across heterogeneous models on language and vision benchmarks.

contradictions.description: Some works show calibration significantly improves selective prediction (e.g., skin lesion), while others note that calibration gains may be limited under distribution shift or for certain model types.
